GeneralInfo.Name: MP-TVSeries
GeneralInfo.Author: ltfearme
GeneralInfo.ExtensionDescription:
MP-TVSeries is a popular TV Series plug-in for MediaPortal. It focuses on managing the user's TV Series library with minimal user interaction, allowing for a more user friendly and ease of use experience.
The MP-TVSeries plugin will scan your hard drive (including network and removable drives) for video files, it then analyzes them by their path structures to determine if they are TV Shows. If the file(s) are recognized then the plugin will go online and retrieve information about them. You can then browse, manage and play your episodes from inside MediaPortal in a nice graphical layout.

GroupItem.Name: TraktPlugin
GroupItem.Description:
Trakt for MediaPortal actively keeps a record of what TV shows and movies you are watching. Based on your favorites, your friends, and the community, trakt recommends other TV shows and movies.
Trakt can also help you keep your watched flags in sync across multiple computers.

GroupItem.Name: ExtensionsPlugin
GroupItem.Description: The Extensions plugin for MediaPortal allows you to browse, install, update and uninstall plugin/skin extensions all from the GUI.

GroupItem.Name: TrailersPlugin
GroupItem.Description:
Trailers plugin allows streaming of Movie, Show, Season and Episode videos (trailers, teasers, clips and featurettes). If no associated video is found at themoviedb.org then you can manually search on YouTube, iTunes or IMDb.
Trailers can be accessed from the F9 context menu (INFO button on remote).

GeneralInfo.Name: MP-TVSeries
GeneralInfo.Author: Mark Willmer (community version of the MP-TVSeries team's plugin)
GeneralInfo.ExtensionDescription:
MP-TVSeries is a popular TV Series plug-in for MediaPortal. It focuses on managing the user's TV Series library with minimal user interaction, allowing for a more user friendly and ease of use experience.
The MP-TVSeries plugin will scan your hard drive (including network and removable drives) for video files, it then analyzes them by their path structures to determine if they are TV Shows. If the file(s) are recognized then the plugin will go online and retrieve information about them. You can then browse, manage and play your episodes from inside MediaPortal in a nice graphical layout.
GeneralInfo.VersionDescription: Community version of MP-TVSeries - install only if you choose to; it replaces the official MP-TVSeries. * New in 4.7: free show information from TMDB - no subscription, nothing to sign up for. * New in 4.7.0.6: Recently Added lists the series with new episodes; Torrent Search is first in the Info menu. * New in 4.8: TVmaze as a backup for shows TMDB doesn't have, and a Continue Watching view. * 4.8.0.2: Configuration opens on the Details tab, a Hide Watched box there, and Recently Added only shows seasons with new episodes. * 4.8.0.3: Continue Watching lists the show you watched last first; MediaPortal reopens the show and season you were in; Recently Added (with Unwatched only on) leaves out shows that have nothing unwatched to show. * 4.8.2.6: renamed or moved files keep the details MediaInfo already read - a big rename no longer means reading every file again at the next import. * 4.8.2.5: MP-TVSeries Configuration opens on the tab you were on last time. * 4.8.2.4: the renamer always uses MyTorrents' naming styles when they're set (When finished tab) - those are greyed in the renamer and changed in MyTorrents, so both always name things the same; a show-folder style without the rating. * 4.8.2.3: Save and Save and close along the bottom of Configuration, on every tab (changes are still saved as you make them - these make sure, and say so); the window can be made much smaller (it couldn't go below 1219 x 1038, taller than a laptop screen), always opens on the screen, and its tabs and panels scroll instead of cutting things off. * 4.8.2.2: the desktop icon step finds the MediaPortal folder from the installer's own location (more reliable). * 4.8.2.1: the desktop icon stays where you put it - updates no longer delete it and make a new one (Windows put the new one in the next free spot); it's only made when it's missing. * 4.8.2.0: the TV renamer - Details tab, right-click a show (or season): "Rename files...", or "Rename files of all shows, one by one...". The show folder first (type over it if you like), then the season folders and episode files with ticks; titles from the online data; subtitles, .nfo and thumbnails go with their episode; the database follows (no rescan); "Undo the last rename". Naming styles start out the same as MyTorrents' When finished settings. Import wizard: "Skip this file / this show's files for now" - not offered again until you bring them back (wizard, or right-click the show). * 4.8.1.2: files waiting to be matched keep their "not matched yet" record - the clean-up after an import no longer removes it when the episode number doesn't exist on TheTVDB (MythBusters S02E05 when its seasons are years), and matching one of two files with the same number no longer takes the record away from the other. * 4.8.1.1: files that had lost their "not matched yet" record (after a clean-up) were never tried again - 421 files on the HTPC, 293 of them MythBusters; each import now puts those records back first so the files are matched again. * 4.8.1.0: first proper (not test) release of the community fork. Episodes whose numbers don't line up with TheTVDB: "E66" in a Season 01 folder carries on into season 2 when season 1 has fewer episodes; shows whose seasons are years on TheTVDB (MythBusters, Looney Tunes) - S01 is the first year; otherwise the title in the file name finds the episode. With no title to check, the guess is shown in the import wizard as "[best guess - please check]" and never taken on its own. The installer now stops the MyTorrents background helper first (it kept the old file in use, so the install didn't take) and starts it again afterwards. * 4.8.0.9: Details tab - 'Tick several' puts tick boxes on the list, 'Delete ticked...' deletes all the ticked shows, seasons and episodes together; right-click a show or season > 'Delete several...' (with 'tick the ones whose files are gone'); shows never matched online that have no files left (left over after files were renamed) are removed automatically. * 4.8.0.8: shows a scan can't match go into a "Needs your help" list (Pick / Search / Skip / Skip all) instead of a pop-up for each - in Configuration at the end of the scan, and scans in MediaPortal save them for Configuration instead of popping up on the TV; episode numbers with no season ("Show - E03 (Title)") are read as season 1, or the Season folder's number; "Scan on startup" is off for new installs; Configuration's tabs scroll instead of squashing on small screens or with bigger Windows text. * 4.8.0.7: in Configuration > Import, right-click a file to look the show up on TheTVDB or TMDb. * 4.8.0.6: unticking "Scan remote shares every ... minutes" now really stops the share scan (it used to run anyway, reading the whole NAS every few minutes). * 4.8.0.5: the Scan tick on each import folder is safe - unticked folders are skipped by scans and keep their episodes (before, the next scan removed them); right-click a folder to scan just that one now or remove it; adding a folder offers to scan just it; episodes handed over by MyTorrents no longer start a full online update of every show; the remote-share scan compares files much faster. * 4.8.0.4: Latest lists series (like Recently Added); shows no longer drop off Continue Watching after an online update (and the lost ones come back); views open quickly again. * Or enter your own TheTVDB subscriber PIN on the Online Data tab to use TheTVDB instead. * Shows matched from .tvdb / tvshow.nfo / series.xml ID files; same-named shows kept apart. * Trakt community ratings for series, seasons and episodes, without the Trakt plugin. * English titles for foreign-language shows, artwork and import fixes. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Includes the official 4.5.1.756 fixes. Back up your database before installing. If you don't like it, simply uninstall it and go back to the original MP-TVSeries you had before.
